messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians can enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, giving you at least two consecutive days off.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed on Monday Jan 2 because Jan 1 was a Sunday) | 2‑day weekend (Sunday Jan 1 + Monday Jan 2) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri 20–Sun 22) |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed on Monday Jul 3 because Jul 1 was a Saturday) | 3‑day weekend (Sat 1–Mon 3) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday – 3‑day weekend (Fri 1–Sun 3) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday – 3‑day weekend (Fri 6–Sun 8) |
| **Dec 25–26** | Christmas & Boxing Day | Christmas on Monday, Boxing Day on Tuesday – 3‑day weekend (Fri 22–Sun 24) |
